title: Assistant Vice President, Global Managed Services Operations (India)
description:
**Assistant Vice President, Global Managed Services Operations (India)**

**Location:** India (Remote)


**Employment Type:** Full\-Time


**About Altera Digital Health**

Altera Digital Health is a global healthcare technology company committed to advancing the future of healthcare through innovative software, services, and managed solutions. Our portfolio includes Sunrise™, Paragon®, TouchWorks® EHR, dbMotion™, HealthQuest™, Ventus™, Altera Opal™, and other solutions that support healthcare organizations worldwide.


Altera is part of Harris Computer and operates within Constellation Software Inc. (CSI), one of the world's most successful software organizations. CSI is a global provider of mission\-critical software and services serving customers across dozens of industries worldwide and is recognized as one of the largest vertical market software companies globally. Backed by CSI's long\-term investment philosophy and commitment to operational excellence, Altera offers the stability, scale, and innovation needed to shape the future of healthcare technology and adjacent emerging markets.


At the intersection of technology and human outcomes, Altera is helping organizations transform operations, improve performance, and deliver better experiences for patients, caregivers, and consumers around the world.


**Position Summary**

Altera Digital Health is seeking an accomplished **Assistant Vice President, Global Managed Services Operations** to serve as the senior executive leader for our India\-based Managed Services organization.


Reporting to executive leadership, this role will be responsible for overseeing a large\-scale global delivery organization supporting healthcare IT and other emerging technology markets. The successful candidate will provide strategic leadership for service delivery, operational excellence, financial performance, workforce development, client satisfaction, and digital transformation initiatives.


This executive will act as both a hands\-on client\-facing leader and an organizational leader responsible for building, developing, and inspiring high\-performing teams. The role requires deep experience in **IT Consulting, Managed Services, Professional Services, or Outsourcing organizations** , along with a proven track record of leading complex global operations and driving organizational transformation.


The ideal candidate will combine strong business acumen, operational discipline, market awareness, and a passion for innovation, particularly in leveraging Artificial Intelligence to enhance service delivery, productivity, client outcomes, and employee effectiveness.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership**

* Serve as the executive leader for Altera's India Managed Services operations.
* Develop and execute a multi\-year strategy that aligns with corporate objectives, market opportunities, and client needs.
* Partner with executive leadership to identify global growth opportunities across healthcare IT and emerging technology markets.
* Drive continuous operational transformation and organizational maturity.

**Client Executive Engagement**

* Build trusted executive\-level relationships with clients across North America, Europe, Asia\-Pacific, and other global markets.
* Act as a strategic advisor to customers regarding service optimization, digital transformation, AI adoption, and operational improvement opportunities.
* Ensure exceptional client satisfaction, retention, and expansion outcomes.
* Participate in executive business reviews, client escalations, and strategic planning sessions.

**Managed Services \& Operational Excellence**

* Lead large\-scale delivery teams responsible for application services, managed services, consulting services, support operations, and professional services engagements.
* Establish best\-in\-class delivery practices, governance models, service management processes, and operational controls.
* Utilize metrics, KPIs, and analytics to drive accountability, efficiency, quality, and client outcomes.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence.

**Financial \& Business Leadership**

* Own P\&L performance for assigned business functions, delivery organizations, and cost centers.
* Leverage new technologies to drive revenue growth, profitability, margin expansion, resource optimization, and operational efficiencies.
* Support sales, solutioning, pricing strategy, and business development initiatives.
* Identify and manage organizational, operational, financial, and delivery risks.

**AI \& Digital Transformation Leadership**

* Lead the organization's evolution toward greater adoption of Artificial Intelligence and automation capabilities.
* Develop strategies to improve service delivery effectiveness through generative AI, predictive analytics, intelligent automation, and emerging technologies.
* Champion innovation while establishing practical governance, adoption frameworks, and measurable business outcomes.
* Enable teams to leverage AI as a force multiplier for productivity, quality, and customer value.

**People Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing management team and global workforce.
* Build leadership pipelines and succession plans to support sustained organizational growth.
* Foster an inclusive, collaborative, and performance\-oriented culture.
* Establish clear objectives, accountability measures, coaching practices, and professional development programs.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10\+ years of progressive leadership experience in IT Services, Managed Services, Professional Services, Consulting, Outsourcing, or related technology organizations.
* 10\+ years leading large\-scale global delivery teams and client\-facing operations.
* 7\+ years of executive leadership experience with responsibility for P\&L management, organizational performance, and strategic planning.
* Demonstrated success leading geographically distributed teams serving global clients.
* Strong executive presence with ability to engage effectively with customers, industry leaders, and senior stakeholders.
* Experience driving operational transformation and process improvement initiatives.
* Track record of developing high\-performing teams and leadership talent.
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing revenue, margins, utilization, and operational metrics.
* Deep understanding of service delivery frameworks, governance models, staffing strategies, and customer success programs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within Healthcare IT, IT Infrastructure, Digital Health, Electronic Health Records (EHR), Clinical Systems, Revenue Cycle, or Adjacent Healthcare Technology markets.
* Experience supporting other regulated industries and emerging technology markets.
* Proven experience driving AI, automation, and digital transformation programs.
* Experience working within large consulting organizations, managed services providers, healthcare technology firms, or global outsourcing companies.
* Knowledge of ITIL, Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, or other service management frameworks.
* MBA, Master's Degree, or equivalent advanced education preferred.
* Strong understanding of global market trends impacting Managed Services, Healthcare Technology, Artificial Intelligence, and Digital Transformation.

title: Head of SaaS Sales (Growth Stage / Mid-Market focus)
description:
**Role Overview**


* **Location:** Remote (Open to candidates located **anywhere in India**)
* **Employment Type:** Full\-time


We are looking for a high\-energy, data\-driven **Head of SaaS Sales** to scale our commercial engine. We have strong product\-market fit, an expanding pipeline, and are ready to systematically dominate the mid\-market segment.


In this role, you will transition our sales motion into a highly predictable, repeatable revenue machine. Mid\-market selling at our company requires a balance of speed and sophistication—you will lead a team that navigates multi\-stakeholder deals (typically 3–6 decision\-makers) with contract values that demand a consultative approach. You will manage the entire sales org, build outbound playbooks, and scale a team of high\-performing mid\-market Account Executives.

**Scaling \& Infrastructure**


* **Process Standardization:** Define, instrument, and enforce CRM workflows (HubSpot/Salesforce) to track key velocity metrics: pipeline coverage, stage conversion rates, and average sales cycle length.
* **Hiring \& Onboarding:** Standardize onboarding to ramp new mid\-market AEs to full quota productivity within 60 days.
* **Comp \& Quota Design:** Structure mid\-market commission plans, SPIFFs, and quota tiers that align with company ARR goals and net\-revenue retention (NRR).


**Executive Deal Support**


* **Deal Strategy:** Act as the strategic executive sponsor on high\-value mid\-market deals, stepping into late\-stage negotiations to accelerate closing.
* **Forecasting:** Deliver accurate, weekly pipeline forecasts to the executive leadership team based on verifiable stage metrics.


**Requirements \& Qualifications**


* **SaaS Experience:** 5\+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with a proven track record specifically selling to or managing teams in the **mid\-market / mid\-segment** space.
* **Leadership Track Record:** 2\+ years of sales management experience in a fast\-paced, growth\-stage startup environment.
* **Deal Metrics Expertise:** Deep understanding of mid\-market sales cycle physics, including experience handling average deal sizes ranging from â‚¹2,000,000 to â‚¹8,000,000\+ ARR.
* **Methodology:** Mastery of consultative sales frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC, Gap Selling, SPICED) tailored for mid\-segment buyers.

title: Sr .Enterprise Account Executive - GCC
description:
**Company Description**  

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**  

You will produce new business sales revenue from a SaaS license model. You will accomplish this through account planning, territory planning, researching prospect customers, using business development strategies and completing field\-based sales activities within a defined set of prospects, territory or vertical.


You'll build new business in GCC accounts by partnering with AI/Intelligent Automation CoE leaders, GBS leadership, Data \& Analytics leaders, and Engineering teams to deploy AI at scale—accelerating process automation, unlocking data\-driven decisions, and proving measurable productivity gains against their global innovation mandate. This role demands account strategy rooted in GCC P\&L mechanics, multi\-stakeholder navigation (CoE through C\-suite), and the ability to size deals around AI\-driven transformation ROI—not just licensing. You'll own a portfolio of GCC Accounts and execute field\-based account plans that move from AI CoE discovery through CFO\-led business case validation.

 **What you get to do in this role:**

* Build and orchestrate multi\-stakeholder account strategies—starting with AI/Intelligent Automation CoE leaders, GBS heads, and Data \& Analytics leaders based in the GCC, then presenting business cases to global CFOs, CIOs, and regional COOs who drive budget and strategic approval
* Map and navigate complex GCC decision\-making structures, identifying which leaders own transformation mandates, data strategy, and cost\-avoidance metrics
* Be a trusted transformation advisor: understand GCC P\&L drivers, regulatory constraints, and local productivity mandates—then position how ServiceNow AI unlocks value that resonates with both GCC leadership and global finance/strategy buyers
* Orchestrate specialist resources (Solutions Consultants, AI specialists, Professional Services, product experts, partners) into deals at critical moments—CoE validation, business case build, implementation roadmap
* Execute vertical (GCC\-specific) and horizontal (cross\-function AI plays) sales strategies, scaling your territory while building a pipeline of Tier\-1 GCC accounts
* Lead account planning that moves from CoE discovery through CFO\-led business case validation, ensuring both innovation credibility and financial rigor
* Develop and collaborate with cross functional team through GCC\-specific deal complexity—stakeholder navigation, ROI methodology, multi\-quarter sales cycles
* Manage forecasting and communications with discipline, translating pipeline activity into predictable revenue
* Establish and nurture relationships at CoE leadership and C\-suite levels, becoming the trusted advisor on GCC AI transformation strategy
* Drive customer success practices and long\-term account expansion strategy post\-close

  

**Qualifications** **To be successful in this role you have:**

description:
**JD \- Senior Lead Generation \& Inside Sales Lead**
-----------------------------------------------------

**Experience:** 7–9 Years**Shift:** US Business Hours (Eastern/Central/Pacific)**Location:** Remote / Office\-based (As per company policy)**Industry Focus:** Healthcare \& Life Sciences (Highly Preferred)### **Position Summary**


We are looking for a high\-energy, tech\-savvy **Senior Lead Generation and Inside Sales Lead** to spearhead our top\-of\-funnel growth. With 7–9 years of experience, you aren't just a "caller"; you are a strategic hunter who understands how to navigate complex B2B landscapes, specifically within the **Healthcare and Life Sciences** sectors.
You will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying high\-value prospects using a modern, multichannel approach. You must be comfortable working **US shifts** and possess exceptional English communication skills to engage with C\-suite executives and key decision\-makers.### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Multichannel Prospecting:** Execute a sophisticated outreach strategy combining cold calling, personalized emailing, LinkedIn social selling, and video prospecting.
* **Pipeline Management:** Identify and qualify SQLs (Sales Qualified Leads) for the account executive team, ensuring a consistent flow of high\-value opportunities.
* **Strategic Research:** Use deep\-dive research to map out large healthcare organizations and life sciences firms, identifying key stakeholders (Directors, VPs, and C\-Suite).
* **AI Integration:** Leverage AI tools (like ChatGPT, Jasper, or Lavender) to personalize outreach at scale, improve response rates, and automate repetitive administrative tasks without losing the "human touch."
* **Data Hygiene:** Maintain a pristine CRM environment (HubSpot) by tracking all interactions, updating deal stages, and providing accurate weekly forecasts.
* **Content Collaboration:** Work with Marketing to provide feedback on lead quality and help refine messaging based on real\-world prospect feedback.

### **Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 7–9 years in Lead Generation, Inside Sales, or Business Development, with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding quotas.
* **Communication:** Flawless verbal and written English. You must be able to articulate complex value propositions clearly and confidently.
* **The Tech Stack:** \* **Prospecting:** Expert\-level proficiency in **LinkedIn Sales Navigator** and **Apollo.io**.
	+ **CRM:** Advanced experience with **HubSpot** (or Salesforce).
	+ **Sales Tech:** Experience with sequencing tools, data enrichment platforms, and AI\-driven sales enablement software.
* **Domain Expertise:** A background or previous stint in **Healthcare or Life Sciences** is a massive advantage. You should understand the nuances of HIPAA, clinical trials, or provider/payer landscapes.
* **Shift Flexibility:** Must be fully committed to working during **US business hours** to ensure real\-time engagement with our primary market.

### **The Ideal Candidate Profile**


"You are a 'Modern Seller.' You don't rely on brute\-force calling alone. You use data to find the right person, AI to craft the perfect message, and multichannel tactics to meet them where they are."* **Analytical:** You look at conversion rates and know exactly which lever to pull to improve them.
* **Resilient:** You view "no" as a data point, not a rejection.
* **Adaptable:** You stay ahead of the curve with new sales technologies and lead\-gen methodologies.

title: Director – MES Practice Lead
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**

**Job Title:** Director – MES Practice Lead (Global Delivery Center India)

**Job Family:** Services Delivery / Digital Manufacturing (MES)

**Location:** Global Delivery Center (GDC)

**Reporting:** Reports to GDC Leadership; strong matrix alignment with Regional MES Practice Lead

**Purpose**


Lead and scale the MES Services business for the Global Delivery Center by building a strong MES competency, driving delivery excellence, and improving margins through standardization and templatization. This role partners closely with the regional counterpart to support growth, shape pipeline, and ensure successful execution for existing and new customers—while applying a strong **people\-first** leadership approach.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Practice \& Business Leadership**

* Own the GDC MES practice roadmap aligned with global/regional MES strategy.
* Define and manage the practice operating model: engagement, delivery readiness, resourcing, capability growth, and knowledge management.
* Partner with regional MES leaders to align offerings, priorities, and execution approach.

**Program Leadership (Leading from the Front)**

* Lead large and complex MES programs “from the front” with strong ownership of outcomes, stakeholder alignment, and execution rigor.
* Set the bar for execution excellence across program management, solution delivery, and customer communication.

**Delivery Excellence \& Governance**

* Establish and enforce project governance across MES programs (scope, schedule, risk, quality, and stakeholder management).
* Ensure consistent delivery standards, templates, and quality gates across all projects.
* Provide leadership for escalations, enable corrective actions, and institutionalize lessons learned.

**Standardization, Templatization \& Margin Improvement**

* Build and maintain reusable assets (delivery playbooks, templates, accelerators, estimation models, reference architectures).
* Drive productivity and margin improvements by increasing reuse and reducing delivery variability.
* Track and improve practice KPIs (margin, utilization, schedule predictability, quality, CSAT).

**MES Competency Development (Capability Building)**

* Develop MES techno\-functional capability across architecture, configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and hyper care.
* Define skill matrices, learning paths, certifications, mentoring plans, and succession pipeline.
* Establish communities of practice and continuous improvement mechanisms across delivery teams.

**People Leadership (People First)**

* Lead, coach, and mentor practice leaders, project managers, architects, and delivery teams.
* Build a high\-performing culture with strong engagement, accountability, and career growth.
* Drive performance management, talent development, and retention initiatives.

**Customer Engagement \& Pipeline Growth**

* Engage with existing customers to strengthen relationships, improve satisfaction, and expand scope/footprint.
* Support pre\-sales with discovery workshops, solution shaping, proposals, estimations, risk reviews, and delivery strategy.
* Drive pipeline growth in partnership with sales and regional MES leadership.

**Qualifications / Experience**

* **Minimum 15\+ years of experience in MES Services**, including end\-to\-end delivery ownership and services leadership.
* Proven experience **leading large MES programs from the front** (multi\-site / multi\-geography programs preferred), including go\-live leadership and executive stakeholder management.
* Strong MES techno\-functional expertise with end\-to\-end delivery ownership.
* Demonstrated success in improving margins via standardization, templatization, and governance.
* Strong executive stakeholder management, communication, and customer\-facing leadership.
* Track record of building and scaling competencies, teams, and delivery leaders.

**Critical Skills**

* Excellent people management and coaching capability; strong “people\-first” mindset.
* Practice leadership: operating model, governance, metrics, delivery excellence.
* Business acumen: profitability/margins, utilization, productivity, pipeline contribution.
* Collaboration: strong partnership with regional counterpart and cross\-functional teams.
* Customer engagement: credibility to lead workshops, escalations, and value discussions.

**Preferred Qualifications**


AVEVA platform experience preferred, with demonstrated exposure to delivering MES solutions leveraging AVEVA technologies (e.g., AVEVA MES / related AVEVA digital manufacturing ecosystem).

**What Success Looks Like**

* A scalable MES delivery model with strong governance and predictable outcomes.
* Measurable margin improvement through reuse and delivery standardization.
* Strong MES competency/bench with clear career paths and reduced key\-person dependency.
* Increased pipeline and expanded customer footprint through proactive engagement.
* High team engagement, retention, and leadership bench strength.

 **India Benefits include:**


Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well\-being support
